summary: NeuroSense Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing it will expand its New Drug Submission to Health Canada for PrimeC, its lead ALS candidate, to include a new neurofilament light chain (NfL) analysis plus unpublished Phase 2b PARADIGM data. The filing target moves to March 2027 from December 2026; Health Canada confirmed no concerns with the revised timing, and its standard NDS review target is roughly 300 calendar days post-acceptance. No transaction, price, stake, or board recommendation is involved. Watch regulatory acceptance timing and any Canadian commercialization partner announcements as the key catalysts.
